cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(SmixxAudio VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET "14.2")
file(GLOB ASPL_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ThirdParty/libASPL/src/*.cpp)
add_library(ASPL STATIC ${ASPL_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(ASPL PUBLIC ThirdParty/libASPL/include)
target_compile_options(ASPL PRIVATE -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-invalid-offsetof)
target_link_libraries(ASPL PUBLIC "-framework CoreFoundation")
add_library(SmixxAudio MODULE Driver.cpp)
target_link_libraries(SmixxAudio PRIVATE ASPL "-framework CoreAudio")
set_target_properties(SmixxAudio PROPERTIES BUNDLE TRUE BUNDLE_EXTENSION driver PREFIX "" SUFFIX ""
  MACOSX_BUNDLE_INFO_PLIST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Info.plist.in")
add_executable(SmixxTimelineTests Tests/TimelineTests.cpp)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME timeline COMMAND SmixxTimelineTests)
add_executable(SmixxDriverContractTests Tests/DriverContractTests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(SmixxDriverContractTests PRIVATE ASPL "-framework CoreAudio")
add_test(NAME driver-contract COMMAND SmixxDriverContractTests)
enable_language(C)
add_library(SmixxProbeDSP STATIC ../Sources/MixerDSP/MixerDSP.c ../Sources/MixerDSP/SMEffects.c)
target_include_directories(SmixxProbeDSP PUBLIC ../Sources/MixerDSP/include)
add_executable(SmixxTransportProbe Tools/TransportProbe.cpp)
target_link_libraries(SmixxTransportProbe PRIVATE SmixxProbeDSP "-framework AudioToolbox" "-framework CoreAudio" "-framework CoreFoundation")
